name: pine-ui
description: Modern React component library with design tokens
author: Pine UI

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @pine-ui/tokens run build && pnpm --filter @pine-ui/react run build
scripts.release:patch: npm run version:patch && npm run build && npm run publish:all && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:minor: npm run version:minor && npm run build && npm run publish:all && git push --follow-tags
